name: Voice Listening
description: Acoustic perception: wake-word detection, continuous speech recognition, and acoustic environment classification.
capabilities: Elegant live transcript on the display, adapting to the PC's performance
Encrypted log of what it hears, with playback and feedback to improve
Microphone test from the panel: live level, 5-second recording to play back and optional equalization

settings.NUXIVA_ONLINE_STT_MODEL: Custom server: model name (e.g. google/gemma-3n-E4B-it or whisper-large-v3)
settings.NUXIVA_EAR_LIVE_SPEAKER: Recognise who is speaking during transcription
settings.NUXIVA_CAPTIONS_HOLD: Seconds the text stays after the sentence (2 - 30)
settings.NUXIVA_EAR_JOURNAL_AUDIO: Also keep the audio of sentences
settings.NUXIVA_EAR_JOURNAL_FULL: Fully transcribe sentences not addressed to the assistant
settings.NUXIVA_EAR_JOURNAL_MAX_MB: Maximum space for the log audio (MB, 20 - 5000)
settings.NUXIVA_EAR_EQ_HIGHPASS: Low cut for rumble and hum, in Hz (0 = off, up to 300)

help.NUXIVA_MIC_AGC: Automatic: NUXIVA measures your voice and, if the microphone is too loud or distorts, it turns on the browser volume control by itself, which lowers the microphone in the system. Yes: always on. No: never.
help.NUXIVA_ONLINE_STT_URL: Any server with the OpenAI-compatible transcription API (/v1/audio/transcriptions). The API key is optional.
help.NUXIVA_EAR_LIVE: Automatic: the transcript appears as you speak and pauses by itself if the PC is under load or too slow, then tries again. Always on: never pauses. Off: text only appears when the sentence ends.
help.NUXIVA_CAPTIONS_SCOPE: Everything it hears also includes conversations in the room that are not meant for the assistant.
help.NUXIVA_EAR_JOURNAL: Saves every sentence understood with who said it, so in the Listening log app you can correct it and improve recognition. Text and audio are encrypted on the device.
